meta.notes: A configured ore feature: one vein of up to 5 glowshard ore blocks. Each target replaces the blocks of one tag with the ore: #minecraft:stone_ore_replaceables holds stone, granite, diorite and andesite, #minecraft:deepslate_ore_replaceables deepslate, the tags vanilla ores use. On its own a feature places nothing: the placed feature msm_examples:ore_glowshard_placed says where and how often.
